title: ALR Setup batch turns screen redraw back on mid-batch
prompt: This is the Alberta Law Review editing template (ALR_V1). The Setup batch (frmALRSetup, cmdRun_Click) disables Application.ScreenUpdating for the whole batch, but profiling shows that every stage after 'Styling abstract' runs with redraw enabled, which makes the later stages slow. Find where a routine in the batch forces ScreenUpdating back to True instead of restoring the caller's value, and fix it (and any sibling routines with the same defect) so that a routine never leaves ScreenUpdating in a different state than it found it. Keep all other behavior identical. Verify in real Word by calling the routine with ScreenUpdating already False and checking it is still False afterwards.
